professionalSummary.text: Maintains routing, triggers and automation rules in a help-desk platform.
professionalSummary.witness: Rebuilt the Zendesk routing rules at Echofield Voice so that chats and tickets go to queues by product line and customer tier, and retired 40 triggers that no longer fired.

experienceHighlights.text: Builds staffing forecasts for support queues from historical contact volumes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the weekly staffing forecast for the phone and chat queues in Python from 18 months of contact volumes, using Erlang C to set agents per half-hour interval.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Runs a ticket quality-sampling programme with a written scoring guide.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Ran the quality-sampling programme, scoring five resolved tickets per agent each month against a written scoring guide agreed with the team leads.

skills.text: Prepares quarterly business review material for the customer experience director.
skills.witness: Put together the support section of the quarterly business review deck (volumes, backlog, staffing) for the customer experience director over four quarters.
